sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Oncology reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 1. The compound gefitinib was discussed with target EGFR in the context of non-small-cell lung cancer. The example mutation is L858R. A demonstration IC50 measurement of 98 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0001 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0001.
